messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — elevated 5xx rate detected from model-serving runtime (inference-node pool). Metric: 5xx rate jumped from 0.4% to 18% at ~12:07 UTC. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/stream. Paging on-call.

eric_oncall: I’m on it. pulling logs now, tagging @alice_sre and @bob_runtime for runtime-level triage.

alice_sre: seeing repeated segfaults in model-runner on several hosts. quick grep shows `SIGSEGV` around kv cache fill.

bob_runtime: confirmed. stack traces show crash in native kernel when allocating large attention cache; likely OOM-ish but kill is segfaulting before cleanup. posting sample trace.

bob_runtime: ```
[2026-03-15T12:06:54Z] model-runner[pid:3241] SIGSEGV at 0x7f8a3bff
#0 0x7f8a3bff in kv_cache_push+0x24 
#1 0x7f8b44aa in attention_concat+0x1f2 
#2 0x7f8c11ab in inference_step
Killed by signal 11 (Segmentation fault)
```

carla_prod: any customer-impact numbers yet? Support reporting increased 500s from customers on autopilot features.

dana_support: ticket volume up 6x for customers hitting generation timeouts. top impacted tenant ids: cust-453, cust-1204, cust-998. ETA on mitigation? customers on Dedicated seeing same pattern.

eric_oncall: initial impact calc: 15% of total traffic got 5xx in the 12:06-12:12 window; tail latency also spiked. marking incident P1.

alice_sre: mitigation plan proposal: 1) drain affected node pool from load balancer 2) roll a runtime config that reduces kv cache prefetch (cuts peak mem) 3) enable model fallback routing to smaller variant. Any objections?

bob_runtime: agree. add step: temporarily increase ulimit for core and decrease RLIMIT_AS for runaway alloc? might be risky. Alternative: force fallback to CPU-backed runner for affected models to keep latency higher but avoid crashes.

frank_engineer: I can push a routing override to send 80% of traffic to model-x-small (quantized) and 20% to original, to limit memory pressure. will prepare canary.

gina_customer_ops: flagging high-value customers (cust-1204) for manual outreach if mitigation extends beyond 30m.

eric_oncall: executing drain now on nodes showing segfault patterns. command: `kubectl cordon node/infer-rt-12 && kubectl drain node/infer-rt-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

incident-bot: Deploy job started by eric_oncall: runtime-config/kv-cache-reduce @ 12:14 UTC (job id: dj-8792).

alice_sre: after drains, error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in 4m. still above baseline. logs show fewer SIGSEGVs but occasional OOM-kill traces.

bob_runtime: pushed runtime tweak: kv_cache_lru_threshold=0.6 -> 0.4, disabled prefetch threads. Also turned on slower path for attention computation (safer kernel).

bob_runtime: ```
# runtime-config diff
- kv_cache_prefetch_threads: 8
+ kv_cache_prefetch_threads: 2
- attention_fastpath_enabled: true
+ attention_fastpath_enabled: false
```

frank_engineer: routing override applied at 12:21 UTC. traffic split in place. Monitoring health for 10m.

carla_prod: good to note: billing not affected, but customers saw increased token errors. adding to status page: short degraded service for generation endpoints. posting draft.

dana_support: customers cust-453 and cust-998 reported transient errors then recovered after fallback started. cust-1204 still seeing intermittent timeouts — open high-priority support case.

eric_oncall: next steps: 1) keep draining problematic hosts 2) observe for 30m 3) if stable, schedule rolling restart with patched runtime (fix attempted) 4) prepare postmortem and customer-impact summary.

alice_sre: I’m uploading a bundle of core dumps and coredumpctl output to the incident bucket for analysis. link: https://internal/s3/incidents/3799991234/coredumps

bob_runtime: doing deeper debug now; hypothesis: memory corruption in attention_fastpath when kv cache reaches a certain size combined with a rare alignment issue on newer kernels. priority fix: add bounds check and fallback to safe path on error. I’ll open a PR.

frank_engineer: PR created: github.com/redwood/inference/runtime/pull/867 — includes safer bounds checks and extra telemetry to catch wrong sizes. will run CI then can roll forward if green.

gina_customer_ops: prepping customer comms for those affected and adding targeted apologies to cust-1204 contact.

eric_oncall: timeline summary to include in postmortem: detection 12:07, paging 12:08, drains & config tweaks 12:14-12:22, routing fallback 12:21, error rate down to ~1% by 12:35, ongoing verification until 13:20.

alice_sre: marking incident as "mitigated" for now. leaving postmortem owner to @bob_runtime and @alice_sre. please keep logs and dumps for 30d.

incident-bot: Incident P1 mitigated at 12:35 UTC. Incident channel will remain open for follow-up until postmortem filed.

dana_support: will follow up with customers in the morning and include timeline + mitigation steps.

eric_oncall: handing off to @alice_sre for the writeup and to @bob_runtime for the fix. I’m available if rollback needed during rollout. thanks everyone. :heart:
